scope: HttpRepresentation.kt all header instances, content encoding, range parser
DirectDownloader.kt response representation validation, ETag, Content-Range and length checks
ParallelDownloader.kt range probe and worker representation binding
HeaderRepresentationTest.kt, DirectDownloaderTest.kt, ParallelDownloaderTest.kt and ResumeJournal.kt supporting static inspection
positive_observations: Content-Encoding validation examines all header fields and comma-separated codings, rejecting every nonempty non-identity coding. Conflicting Content-Type, Content-Length, Content-Range and ETag fields are rejected before transfer output is opened.

Resume acceptance requires a strong matching ETag, final URL hash, exact range start/end/total and compatible declared body length. Stream consumption additionally enforces the expected total and rejects both overrun and truncation.

Parallel acceleration requires a one-byte 206 probe, strong ETag and usable total; both worker ranges require the same final URL and exact ETag/range, and exact byte counts before merging. Representation errors trigger one sequential fallback without publishing worker pieces.

HeaderRepresentationTest explicitly covers preceding encodings hidden by a final identity header, contradictory repeated representation fields, legal comma-containing opaque ETags, and identical repeated fields. These already-fixed cases are not reported again.
test_gaps: Current repeated-header tests exercise HttpRepresentation directly; end-to-end direct and parallel fixtures do not separately prove contradictory repeated fields leave destination bytes and resume metadata untouched. Static call ordering places the check before output mutation.
runtime_execution: Read-only static review. No source edits, builds, tests, devices or publishing. No additional proven defect found within the assigned header and representation scope.
